description: The agent must: (1) Locate and invoke the distill.py script at ~/.openclaw/skills/notebooklm-distiller/scripts/distill.py using the 'distill' subcommand. (2) Pass --keywords 'Quantum Error Correction' (matching the notebook name) and --topic 'QuantumComputing' and --vault-dir '/workspace/obsidian_vault'. (3) Set --mode summary (not the default 'qa') because the user wants a structured summary. (4) Add --lang zh to generate Chinese output (the proprietary flag that prepends '请用中文回答' to NLM prompts). (5) Add --writeback to push the distillation log back into the notebook — this is the bespoke audit feature from SKILL.md that triggers a 'notebooklm source add' call with the exact title format 'Distill Log: summary | Quantum Error Correction | YYYY-MM-DD'. The output file must appear at /workspace/obsidian_vault/QuantumComputing/Quantum Error Correction_Summary.md with all 8 YAML frontmatter fields (title, date, type, author, tags, source, project, status) and Chinese content in the body. An agent relying on general knowledge would: miss the --writeback flag entirely, use the default --mode qa, not know about --lang zh, and not know the writeback title format.
